text.offer: Ran er'Hoth says, "If you mean to go into that crypt, or anywhere past our walls, carry a cure for poison. The things out there bite, and their bites fester. Lady Aftyn keeps her sanctuary here in Marion and sells the potions. Tell her I sent you: the town keeps a purse with her for newcomers. Buy one from her."
text.progress: Lady Aftyn's Sanctuary is in Marion. Right-click her and choose Quests to talk to her, and Buy to see what she sells.
text.complete: Lady Aftyn says, "Drink it as soon as you feel the poison in your veins, not after. And come back to me whenever you need healing."

steps.objective: Speak to Lady Aftyn the healer
Buy a cure poison potion from Lady Aftyn
steps.brief: Lady Aftyn says, "Ran er'Hoth sent you for a cure? Wise of him. Right-click me, choose Buy, and tick the cure poison potion."
